pages.text:
Pumps Crude Oil out of the deposit under a Well Head.
# Building
A skid of Pumpjack Casings 3 wide and 5 long round the Well Head, which is the middle of one end; the Pumpjack Controller in the middle of the other end, facing away from the well; and three more Pumpjack Casings stacked on the middle of the skid as the Samson post. Formed, it becomes a pumpjack: the walking beam nods on its post, the horse head working the well and the cranks turning at the far end.

# Pumping
It pumps 30 mB/t from a full deposit using 60 FE/t, slowing as the deposit drains to a quarter of that, and rocks as fast as it pumps. A drained deposit still gives 40 mB a second.
# Ports
A new pumpjack has no ports: set them with the Wrench in Port mode.
- Output: Crude Oil out (it pushes it out on its own).
- Energy: FE in.
It also fills buckets put in its bucket slot.
